body:
I just got temp banned for excessive infractions however its a bit over due as my last infraction before this was on he 8th of December.
And I don't feel that a one month temp ban is necessary for the punishment which i have been given, considering other factors.
 Can someone please re evaluate this temp ban.

title: My tempban

replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
Hey _iHack_.
You have received a total of 13 infractions (discounting the tempban) within the past 8 months,
meaning you are eligible for a 30 day temp ban for excessive infractions. 
All factors considered, the length of your punishment and your punishment itself are both 
completely legitimate and completely necessary. 

You can find more information here -> https://avicus.net/forums/6f91bb10e 

The best I as well as yourself can do at this point is to wait out your punishment.
Thanks. 
-Zedther

replies.body_tagged: and also zedther , were checking me for hacks just before?? xD

replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
Purely coincidental I can assure you.
It's not everyday that we run checks on certain members to see
whether or not they have racked up excessive infractions, most of the
time it's by chance.

In addition, people with 30 odd infractions are normally users whom have been
given a second chance after appealing a 20+ infraction permanent ban.

If you do happen to notice people within a boatload of infractions who you believe
are eligible for having excessive infractions, you're more than welcome to report
these players right here on the forums.

Thanks.
-Zedther

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hey _iHack_,

Zedther has done a very good job explaining your tempban to you. Your infraction is valid, as your 13 infractions show that you continued to break the rules after receiving many warnings and punishments. Therefore, you must wait for your tempban to expire, and hopefully, you will not break more rules. Unfortunately, your appeal is denied.

Regards,
Qinn | Senior Moderator
